description: Land Acquisition - Dambuwa, Ihala Meegaswewa, Maho D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including lot numbers, extents, and boundary information. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, making it a clear land-related administrative matter rather than government personnel/structure or other specialized categories.
